{{dablink|For other uses of the words "crystal" and "rod," see [[Crystal]] and [[Rod]].}}
The '''clear crystal rod''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that was stolen from the [[White Tower]] by [[Liandrin's group of Black Sisters]].{{Ref/book|3|25}}

==Appearance==
The rod is made of crystal and is smooth and perfectly clear. It is a foot long and an inch in diameter.{{Ref/book|3|25}}

==Use==
The use of the rod is unknown. Probably it is a [[sleepweaver]] because of the circumstances of the theft and also because it was studied by [[Corianin Nedeal]] along the other stolen objects.{{Ref/book|3|25}}
